title: Nice Art, but pricey for the small size
text: Nice Art, but pricey for the small size. Really nice winter scene, but very pricey for the small size+ it’s missing the 4 corner protectors on the bottom. I wanted to add that the surface texture is very nicely done- it sparkles.
